notes: Hokkaido (Kushiro, Tsurui, Nemuro, Notsuke, Rausu, Shiretoko, Sapporo, Tomakomai), mostly a winter trip: Red-crowned Crane feeding grounds, Steller's and White-tailed Sea-Eagles on the Rausu drift ice, Blakiston's Fish-Owl at the Yoroushi and Rausu inns, sea ducks and auks at Nemuro and Cape Nosappu, northern woodpeckers, grouse and owls of the forests, plus the summer birds of the bogs and coast (grasshopper warblers, Siberian Rubythroat, Tufted Puffin on the Teuri and Yagishiri ferry). Species come from the pack's sample areas (areas.json) and eBird's Hokkaido list, not from the Honshu country score: a bird in the country trip is not repeated here (Whooper Swan, Slaty-backed Gull, Japanese Robin and Japanese Accentor stay in the country trip). Hand-picked. Photos are review-agent picks from unreviewed candidates (not approved on production): check them on /trip-photos. Shaky picks: Mountain Hawk-Eagle (mostly flight/distant shots; ID vs Crested Goshawk/other hawk-eagles uncertain); Sakhalin Leaf Warbler (Sakhalin vs Eastern Crowned/other leaf warblers very hard; low confidence); Blakiston's Fish-Owl (snow/feeding-station photos); Siberian Thrush (many in-hand/dead photos rejected; 946518 is female/immature type); Latham's Snipe (snipe ID relies on Australian locality); Black-browed Reed Warbler (reed warbler ID some doubt); Sakhalin Grasshopper Warbler (skulking species; ID by locale).
